sourceReconciliation.selectedPrimitive: Six independent Paeth byte recurrences in portable Vector128 short lanes. Bounded eight-byte loads, six-byte stores, scalar tail, original tie order/modulo256. Polling within64KiB. Short previous rows/overlap/unsupported hardware retain scalar reconstruction and partial failures. No new heap storage, fields or memory/work admission.
sourceReconciliation.exactSourceProof: Removing the new method and six-byte dispatch restores the entire predecessor PngCodec source byte for byte.
sourceReconciliation.stoppedPassingRgba16Paeth: Stride8 still takes the original first branch and unchanged eight-byte kernel; no retiming.
sourceReconciliation.unaffected: Existing four/eight-byte vector kernels and scalar recurrence are byte-identical. The two measured controls cover changed dispatch. PNG None/Sub8 earlier exits, codec/metadata/edit code, sampling/expansion/inflation and output ownership are unchanged.

linuxInitialFailure.reason: External FFmpeg process WaitForExitAsync reached its one-minute timeout in one nearest-resize case; no pixel assertion failed.
